question: Atom A has an electronegativity of 2.91 and Atom B has an electronegativity of 2.14. Predict the type of bond formed between them.
explanation: ΔEN = |2.91 - 2.14| = 0.77. ΔEN > 2.0 implies Ionic, 0.4 < ΔEN < 2.0 implies Polar covalent, ΔEN <= 0.4 implies Non-polar covalent. Thus it is Polar covalent.

question: In the reaction 3A + 3B -> Products, 11 g of A (M=23 g/mol) reacts with 68 g of B (M=57 g/mol). Which reactant is the limiting reagent?
